title: Cassava Peel Processing Technique Explained 80% Women Farmers Benefit 38-42% Moisture Content 6-8 Hours Drying Time
reason: Explains the innovative method to process cassava peels into high-quality feed products.

tasks.task: Describe the innovative processing method to reduce drying time and produce high-quality cassava peels.

subtasks.text: Note that traditionally, drying cassava peels takes two to three days, but the innovative method shortens drying time to six to eight hours.
Mention the quality concerns with traditionally dried peels, such as contamination by aflatoxins and poor storability.
Explain the new processing method involves removing contaminants, grating, dewatering, and pressing to create an intermediate product.
Describe the next step in producing dried fine and coarse mash by sieving, toasting, or flash drying, depending on conditions.

tasks.task: Highlight the potential benefits and economic opportunities from processing cassava peels.

subtasks.text: Mention the demand from the feed industry for high-quality cassava peel products.
Highlight the opportunity to convert an environmental problem into a valuable resource.
Note that 80% of cassava processors are women, and this could create new income and employment opportunities.
